checks.message: Protocol not explicitly specified. Ensure only secure protocols are used
checks.context: AWS Transfer Family supports SFTP, FTPS, FTP, and AS2. FTP transmits credentials and data in plaintext. Always explicitly specify --protocols SFTP (or FTPS) to prevent unencrypted file transfers.

checks.message: Stopping the server immediately rejects all SFTP/FTPS/FTP connections
checks.context: Any ongoing file transfers are interrupted and clients will receive connection refused errors. Verify no automated processes or business partners are actively transferring files.

checks.message: Verify the update doesn't change the identity provider or expose the endpoint publicly
checks.context: Changing the identity provider affects authentication for all users. Switching from VPC to PUBLIC endpoint type exposes the SFTP server to the internet.
